registration_timing: Before implementation of CMLE calibration-draw sensitivity or inspection of its numerical results.
purpose: Quantify how asymptotic uncertainty in exact-CMLE free structural coefficients moves fixed-calibration Warm-WLE Person scores.

method_contract.draw_distribution: Multivariate normal in exact-CMLE free-coordinate space with mean beta_hat and covariance_scale^2 times the fitted exact conditional-information covariance.
method_contract.covariance_validation: Require finite symmetric covariance and reject materially negative eigenvalues; clip only numerical negative eigenvalues within tolerance.
method_contract.person_scoring: Reconstruct every fit-sample row/category CMLE log kernel for each draw and solve the same fixed-calibration Warm adjusted score.
method_contract.reported_dispersion: CalibrationDrawSD and calibration-draw quantiles; not a confidence interval.
method_contract.quadrature_sensitivity: sqrt(BaselineConditionalWLESE^2 + CalibrationDrawSD^2), labelled sensitivity only and not an inference-qualified total SE.
method_contract.same_sample_dependence: The CMLE calibration and fit-sample WLE scores reuse responses; their dependence is not propagated by independent normal draws.
